fields.Name: IT185 - Comms V2 Send Pipeline and Templated Delivery
fields.Description: Exercises V2SendService.Send (DryRun, tracking tokens, HMAC signatures, chunked comms.dispatch) and TemplatedCommunicationService.RenderAndSend against live SQL Server.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: V2SendService.Send persists runs/logs with tracking tokens, chunks above AsyncThreshold, and TemplatedCommunicationService renders and sends DryRun.
